### 🧟 Infection
- A new PvP mode: 3 seconds into the round one player turns into **Patient Zero**, and everyone a mutant kills turns too. Survivors win if anyone is still human when the clock runs out; mutants win when nobody is.
- Any survivor death infects you, a fall or your own grenade included. Players who join mid-round come in as mutants.
- The last survivor standing runs faster.
- Pick a 3, 5 or 8 minute round and how strong the mutants are: **Easy**, **Normal** or **Hard**. It needs at least 3 players, and bots count.

### 🎒 Survivors
- Survivors gear up from the usual buy menu, with the same economy settings as the other modes, and can keep buying all round.
- Sentries and mines are off the menu in Infection.
- A mutant you kill drops a medkit.

### 🦑 Mutants
- Mutants are tall, fast tentacled creatures. On Normal they have 200 HP and run about 60 % faster than a survivor. Patient Zero has the same HP as every other mutant.
- In first person you see two tentacles that writhe and whip out at whatever you strike.
- The tentacle lash reaches further than a knife and sweeps wide, so it hits survivors who strafe. On Normal it kills a full-health survivor in two hits, wherever it lands.
- Their **Q** is a **zombie ball**: it bursts on impact, and a zombie gets up where it lands and goes after the survivors.
- You can hear mutants grunt and roar before you see them, and their footsteps squelch.
- Bots play both sides.

### ⚙️ Other
- The lobby opens on the PvP mode you last hosted.
- Fixed the lobby sometimes jumping from a map-based mode to Battle Royale when it opened.
- Water reflections now default to low quality.
